title: Private Peggy’s Cove, Citadel & Halifax Highlights Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the best of Halifax and Nova Scotia’s breathtaking coastline on this private sightseeing experience designed for comfort, flexibility, and unforgettable views. Perfect for cruise passengers, couples, families, and small groups, this tour combines scenic beauty, fascinating history, and authentic local culture into one memorable journey.

Visit the world-famous Peggy's Cove, where you’ll explore the iconic lighthouse, rugged granite coastline, and charming fishing village while enjoying incredible Atlantic Ocean views and photo opportunities.

Learn about Nova Scotia’s lobster industry at Ryer Retail before discovering Halifax’s Titanic connection at Fairview Lawn Cemetery. Enjoy panoramic views from Halifax Citadel National Historic Site and relax at the beautiful Halifax Public Gardens.
